rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a full blastocyst and relatively sparse TE, but it overstates certainty about an A-grade ICM from this single image and adds limited-detail observations not clearly discernible.

Integrates age, BMI, tubal factor, ovarian reserve markers, prior cycle, sperm parameters, and endometrium into prognosis well, though it somewhat overemphasizes the prior failed cycle and borderline nature of an 8.3 mm lining.

Reasoning is structured and generally logical, with conclusions broadly supported by embryo grade and patient factors; minor issues include slightly pessimistic weighting of prior failure and endometrial thickness.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET and avoiding routine add-ons; small deviations include framing 8.3 mm as borderline and giving a somewhat conservative prognosis for a young patient with a 2AB blastocyst.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management and future-cycle review, including SET, luteal support, cavity review, and male-factor follow-up, though some suggestions remain general rather than protocol-specific.
